name: clockwize
description: Freelancer management app for clients, projects, tasks and time tracking

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:server" "sleep 2 && npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../desktop && npm install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test && npm run test:e2e
